content:
cd /workspace && cat > /tmp/ft_harness.cpp <<'EOF'
#include <ft2build.h>
#include FT_FREETYPE_H
#include FT_MULTIPLE_MASTERS_H
#include <vector>
#include <memory>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstdlib>
using namespace std;
static FT_Library library;
static void setIntermediateAxis(FT_Face face){
 if(!FT_HAS_MULTIPLE_MASTERS(face)) return;
 FT_MM_Var* variations_ptr=nullptr;
 if(FT_Get_MM_Var(face,&variations_ptr)) return;
 unique_ptr<FT_MM_Var, decltype(free)*> variations(variations_ptr, free);
 vector<FT_Fixed> coords(variations->num_axis);
 for(unsigned int i=0;i<variations->num_axis;i++) coords[i]=(variations->axis[i].minimum+variations->axis[i].def)/2;
 FT_Set_Var_Design_Coordinates(face,(FT_UInt)coords.size(),coords.data());
}
int main(int argc,char**argv){ if(argc<2)return 2; FILE*f=fopen(argv[1],"rb"); if(!f){perror("fopen");return 2;} fseek(f,0,SEEK_END); long n=ftell(f); rewind(f); vector<unsigned char> buf(n); fread(buf.data(),1,n,f); fclose(f); if(FT_Init_FreeType(&library)) return 3; FT_Face face; if(FT_New_Memory_Face(library,buf.data(),(FT_Long)buf.size(),-1,&face)) return 0; long num_faces=face->num_faces; FT_Done_Face(face); for(long face_index=0; face_index<num_faces; face_index++){ if(FT_New_Memory_Face(library,buf.data(),(FT_Long)buf.size(),-(face_index+1),&face)) continue; long num_instances=face->style_flags>>16; FT_Done_Face(face); for(long instance_index=0; instance_index<num_instances+1; instance_index++){ if(FT_New_Memory_Face(library,buf.data(),(FT_Long)buf.size(),(instance_index<<16)+face_index,&face)) continue; if(!FT_Set_Char_Size(face,20*64,20*64,72,72)){ if(instance_index==0) setIntermediateAxis(face); for(unsigned int glyph_index=0; glyph_index<(unsigned int)face->num_glyphs; glyph_index++){ FT_Load_Glyph(face,glyph_index,FT_LOAD_DEFAULT|FT_LOAD_NO_BITMAP); }} FT_Done_Face(face); }} FT_Done_FreeType(library); return 0; }
EOF


cd /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/freetype2 && g++ -g -O0 -fsanitize=address,undefined -Iinclude -I. /tmp/ft_harness.cpp -o /workspace/ft_harness objs/.libs/libfreetype.a -lz -lbz2 -lpng -lm && cd /workspace && for f in repo-vul/src-vul/font-corpus/* poc_zycon.ttf; do echo ===$(basename "$f"); ASAN_OPTIONS=detect_leaks=0 ./ft_harness "$f" >/tmp/hout 2>&1; ec=$?; grep -E 'ERROR: AddressSanitizer|heap-buffer-overflow|WRITE|READ|SUMMARY' /tmp/hout | head -20; echo ec=$ec; [ $ec -ne 0 ] && break; done
